column3: Travelled well in touch wide - hit front with driving urged run 2f out - kept finding under pressure to score comfortably
Set the pace under pressure - driven and lost the front 2f out - stayed on but no answer to winner inside final furlong
Tracked the front group early - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept going without closing the gap late
Sat close to front early - asked for effort 3f out - stayed on gamely before fading inside final furlong - finished fourth beaten 8 lengths
Held up towards the back - urged into effort over 2f out - kept on late but not close enough finishing 5th
Held up towards the back - urged forward approaching the final 3f - stayed on without threatening the leading group - finished sixth
Towards the rear of the main group - nudged for effort 2f out - faded inside the final furlong
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f to go - faded through the closing stages - finished 8th
Settled in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - drifted right and dropped away with 1f to go - finished 9th
Sluggish start - stayed at the back throughout - well held in 10th
Set the pace from the start - pushed along inside the closing furlong and fended off a challenge in the final 110yds - held on to land the verdict
Settled into second early - pressed the leader from just past the furlong marker and pushed along with a shot close home - stayed on but unable to reel in winner at the line
Settled just off the front group early - showed brief agitation closing on the front two inside the final 110yds - stayed on for third
Settled in third early - lost momentum inside the last furlong - dropped away close to the line - finished fourth
Held up towards back of pack - driven approaching final 3f - faded close home to finish fifth
Sluggish start - stayed towards back before nudging into contention a furlong out - stuck on same gait to finish sixth beaten 9¼ lengths
Held up in the pack - lost touch a furlong out - dropped away close home - finished seventh
Held up at the back - lacked pace with the pack - eased past one fading runner in the closing stages - finished eighth
Held up in the pack throughout - lacking fluency under pressure - slipped to the back inside the final furlong - well held at the finish

Sent to front early - soon overtaken and sat behind the pace - settled 3rd after 3f then dropped to 4th with 2 1/2f left - moved out for room turning into the straight - found extra late to hit the front in the shadow of the post

Slow to break - settled towards the back and 8th at the midpoint - made ground wide of rivals 3f out - up to 3rd approaching 2 1/2f out - second turning into the straight - hit the front late on - stayed on well but caught in the final strides - beaten a neck into 2nd
Slow into stride - settled towards the back - moved into 3rd early on - up to 2nd after 3f - improved into contention 5f out - hit front over 3f out - driven and overtaken late then held for 3rd
Settled in the pack early - up to 4th by halfway - made progress into 2nd with 3f left - 3rd turning into the straight - lost a place inside the final furlong and finished with nothing more to give
Held up towards the back of the field - 5th at halfway before slipping to 7th with 4 1/2f left - improved into 6th turning for home - stayed on in same gear to finish 5th
Handy early before slipping backward after 3f - mid-division at halfway - some progress into 6th with 4 1/2f left - asked for effort in 5th entering straight - eventually held in 6th at the finish

Held up handy early - urged to front soon after - stretched clear before halfway - margin shrank with 5f left - overtaken and outpaced approaching the 3f marker - dropped away steadily from 2f out to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - up to 6th by halfway and 5th with 4 1/2f left - dropped away and pushed along over 3f out - faded from 2 1/2f out to finish well beaten

Slow into stride at the start and lost ground - stumbled shortly after - towards the back early - urged forward and moved left to make progress 2f out - up into fourth inside the final furlong - challenged the front-runner approaching 110yds out - edged ahead near the finish to win
Set the early gallop out front - urged into effort with 2f remaining - kept finding more with 1f to run - overtaken close to home - lacked the finishing kick of the winner
Sat behind front group - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on without the speed to get involved
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching 2f out - kept responding under pressure inside final furlong - finished fourth without threatening the front late on
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left and made ground - kept going at an even effort in the last furlong - finished fifth
Tracked leading group early - urged forward with two furlongs left and edged off a straight line - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 7 lengths
Sat close to the front pair early - asked for effort with over 2f left - unable to live with the pace and faded - eventually well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - driven with 2f left - unable to find any headway
Held up in touch with leading group - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost momentum inside the final furlong - finished ninth
Hampered for room at the off - settled towards the back - failed to feature - finished tenth
Settled in midpack early - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to threaten and well held at the finish
Drifted left at the off - settled towards the back - never featured - finished well held
Set the pace from the start - edged clear from 2f out - pushed along inside the final furlong - allowed to coast home well clear
Settled in second early - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on into the straight but couldn't get past inside the final 110 yards - finished second beaten 3¼ lengths
Settled third early - lost touch with front two inside the last furlong - stayed on same gear to the line

Hesitant start - settled towards the back and asked for effort to keep in contention early while fighting the bridle - urged forward to close on the front markers a furlong out - lost momentum inside the closing furlong to finish fourth
Settled towards back of the field - pushed along and slipped to last approaching final two furlongs - fell away inside closing stages - finished fifth
Handy early - third with 5f left - moved to the front two out - went on turning in - opened daylight inside the final furlong - stayed on for an untroubled success
Held up towards the back - still 9th with 5f left - made ground into contention 3f out - fourth and going forward 1f out - finished second best but no match for a clear-cut winner

Settled among the pack early - faded to the back around 5f out - rallied approaching 2f out to move into second entering the straight - unable to peg back the front-runner inside the final furlong - eased back to third late
Held up towards back of the pack - improved position into the straight - stayed on late but never a factor - finished 4th beaten 4.25 lengths
Settled among the pack early - slipped back to 8th with 5f left - unable to threaten leaders approaching 2f out - found renewed momentum inside final furlong - stayed on for 5th at the finish
Settled in midfield early - moved into 5th with 5f left - improved into contention approaching 3f out - pushed along in 4th inside the final furlong before fading late
Held up towards the back - improved into 6th around 5f from home - moved up into contention approaching the 3f marker - unable to threaten leaders and lost ground late
Slow to break - settled towards the back - driven up with 3 1/2f left - found some purpose entering the straight - stayed on late but well beaten in 8th
Sat close up early - hit front soon after - squeezed for effort and gave up advantage approaching 2f out - dropped away in straight and faded late finishing 9th
Handy early - 4th with 5f left - dropped back approaching 3f out - unable to threaten and gave way in the last furlong
Just in front early - swiftly overtaken then second with 5f remaining - dropped back approaching 3f out - pushed along soon after - faded 1 1/2f out to finish 11th
Slow to break - settled towards the back - improved into 7th 5f out - dropped back and faded from 3f out home
Held up at the back - lost touch with 3f left to race - no impact thereafter - finished well beaten in 13th
Handy early - asked for effort with 3f left then hit front inside final furlong - kept finding under pressure to win
Settled at the back - shaken up 3f out and made ground approaching the final 2f - launched a challenge between horses 110yds out - stuck on into second but could not peg back the winner
Sat close to the front group early - asked for effort with 3f left - kept going but flattened out inside final furlong when in contention - finished third beaten 2 1/2 lengths
Sent clear early under pressure - driven out approaching 2f out then lost front spot inside final furlong - stayed on same speed to finish fourth
Sat close to front pack early - urged forward with over 3f left - lost ground approaching 2f out - eventually finished fifth
Handy early - hit the front inside first furlong - stretched advantage from over a furlong out and drew away approaching final furlong - allowed to idle close home to win
Handy early - lost momentum approaching final furlong then found renewed energy to move into second - stayed on but never troubling winner close home
Handy with the front group - moved into second a furlong out - eased back a place late but stayed on to finish third
Settled in the pack early - shifted wide with over 2f left and pushed along a furlong out - stayed on at one gait inside the final 110yds to finish 4th
Settled at back of field - lacked pace with a furlong to go - dropped away close home - finished fifth
Broke to the front - lost the advantage early on then settled just behind - lost touch with the pace a furlong out and dropped away steeply approaching the finish - eventually well held in sixth
Held up at back early - improving by halfway - up into 3rd with 3f left - swept to front over 2f out after drifting wide into the straight - stayed on strongly in the final furlong - won easily
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - moved into 6th with 2½f left - improved to 3rd inside the final furlong - stayed on for second but never able to trouble the winner
Slow to break - settled towards back - made progress into the straight - fourth with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch third at the finish

Settled early - urged forward to take command - driven again 3f out - overtaken just past the 2f marker - slipped to fourth with a furlong left - rallied to hold third briefly in the run-in - edged out of that spot near the line to finish fourth
Settled around midfield - moved into second entering the straight - lost momentum late to finish fifth
Tucked up with the pack early - fourth passing the 3f mark - eased back to sixth entering the straight - stayed on at one speed to finish sixth
Settled with the pack - couldn't land a blow in 7th inside the final furlong - held to the line - finished 7th
Slow to break - settled handy early - faded approaching 3f out - unable to quicken into straight and held to the line finishing 8th
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway with 1 1/2f left - stayed on at one speed to the line - finished 9th
Tracked the pace early - fourth with 4f left - dropped away approaching 3f out - unable to close and faded in the straight
Slow to break - held towards the back - improved position nearing the turn and shifted wide entering the straight - flattened out in the closing stages to finish 11th
Set the pace early - handed up in second before giving way 3f out - dropped away rapidly inside final 2f to finish well beaten
Handy early - dropped into the pack then slipped back over 3f out - dropped away over 2f out to finish well beaten
Settled around midfield - dropped away and struggled with 3f left - faded from contention and allowed to coast home last of all
Tracked the pace from the outside - driven up to challenge inside the final two furlongs - kept responding to get up right at the finish

Settled in midfield towards the wide side - made steady progress into contention with two furlongs left - asked for effort and went clear approaching the final furlong - drifted left inside the last 110yds and was caught right at the line
Sat close to the front group - driven approaching the final furlong with a real shout - stayed on gamely - edged out close home for third

Held a central berth early - asked for effort 2f out then boxed in briefly and shifted left approaching final furlong - denied room again inside 110 yards but rallied strongly - closed fastest of all to finish fourth just 3/4 length off the winner
Slow to start - settled at the back - driven and making progress from 2f out - angled left and keeping on 1f out before checked close home - fifth
Tracked the pace early - dropped back two out - stayed on under pressure - flattened out close home finishing sixth beaten 2.5L
Slow to break - held towards the back - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't land a blow
Set the pace early - urged on with two furlongs left - overtaken approaching the last furlong and weakened to finish 8th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 9th

Settled second early - pressed forward and broke from the pack with the front rival over 3f out - contended for top spot inside the final furlong - asserted inside the last 110yds and pulled ahead to score with something in hand

Sent to the front early - driven on and broke away with one runner approaching 3f out - drifted right under pressure inside the final furlong - overtaken close to home - unable to find more late and edged into second
Settled at back early - urged forward to close in over 2f out - driven to reach front two inside final furlong and stayed on well for third
Settled in third - lost touch with pace over 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished fourth
Held up in the pack - lost touch approaching final two furlongs - dropped away inside the last - finished a well-held 5th
Held up in the pack - nudged into contention 2f out then pushed along briefly - faded before the line finishing sixth
Settled in the pack early - lost touch and slipped towards the back 3f out - well beaten from inside the final furlong - finished last of the field

Settled just behind pace - still second at halfway - moved smoothly to hit the front two furlongs out - pushed on entering the straight - opened a big gap inside the last - held on gamely though margin shrank near the line to score
Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - improved on the outside with a furlong and a half left - into second and kept going a furlong out - unable to close down the winner - finished second
Held up towards the back early - still 7th at halfway - moved into contention approaching the straight - up to 5th inside the final furlong - kept going to finish 3rd
Settled with the pack early - 5th at halfway - pushed along in 4th turning for home - briefly 3rd inside the final furlong before fading back to finish 4th

Quick start to edge in front - overtaken shortly after - sat third at halfway - weakened and driven along with a furlong and a half left - slipped to sixth briefly before finishing fifth with nothing more to give
Settled in the pack early - 4th at halfway - improved into contention over 2f out - briefly disputed 2nd entering the straight - dropped away and faded through the final furlong to finish 6th
Slow to begin and settled last - still 9th at halfway - unable to make headway in 8th with a furlong left - kept on same pace to finish 7th
Settled just behind the pace early - went in front approaching halfway before being caught around 2f out - dropped away entering the straight and finished well beaten
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - 10th at halfway - given a nudge with 2½f left - lost place late and finished well held
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the pack - 6th at halfway - began to struggle over 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong to finish well beaten
Up with the leading duo - moved into second before halfway - driven up to head the field 2f out - drifted left over 1f out - asserted to win going well
Tracked the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on well through the closing stages - grabbed second close home but never good enough to trouble the winner
Sat close to the front early - hit the front before halfway then driven when overtaken 2f out - kept going without extra gear to finish third
Handy in the pack early - ridden on with over 2f left - lost ground in the closing stages
Settled in the pack early - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - faded from there to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort with over 2f left - drifted left soon after and lost touch with the front - trailed home in 6th
Held up towards the back - urged for effort with 2f to go - couldn't find any extra - well held in 7th
Settled at the back early - never got competitive - finished well held in 8th
Fractious at the start - went straight to the front then drifted markedly left approaching halfway and became difficult to control - effort disappeared and was allowed to drop away
Settled in second early - showed brief agitation on hitting the front two out - kept up the pressure inside the final furlong to hold on
Settled third early - closing on the pace two out - moved up to second inside the last - unable to find more late and held for second
Went straight to front early - driven along when overtaken approaching 2f out - asked for more inside final furlong as pace told - kept third under late challenge
Settled at the back early - urged to chase on approaching 1f out - stayed on inside final 110yds but narrowly missed third
Held up towards the back - lost touch early - responded and made late progress inside the closing furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Handy early - third at halfway - moved into second with 2½f left - edged ahead entering the straight - kicked clear inside final 150 yards to hold on strongly

Handy early - shoved on to nose ahead after 1f then knocked off it after 2f - second at halfway - back in front 2f out but overtaken entering the straight - unable to find more late on - beaten 3½ lengths in 2nd
Held up towards the back early - still only 6th at halfway before improving into 4th inside the final 2f - stayed on at one effort to grab 3rd near the line

Fast start to hit the front - overtaken and back in front twice early - lost command approaching 3f out - slipped to third with over two furlongs left - unable to threaten those in command turning in - held on one gear final furlong - eased back to fourth near the line
Settled early with the pack - held 5th at halfway and unable to close into the straight - one paced through the final furlong to finish 5th
Slow to leave stall - dropped towards back early - 7th at halfway - unable to close final stages - held to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early - up to 4th at halfway - unable to make headway 2f out and dropped away soon after - faded 1 1/2f out to finish well held
Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - pushed along with two furlongs left before fading into finish well held
Slow to break - settled at the back of the field - still last at halfway - lost touch inside final 2f and beaten off
Slow to begin - settled at the back - still last of all at halfway - dropped away over 2f out and finished well beaten
Handy early - driven to the front approaching 2f out - opened up daylight nearing the final furlong - stayed on well to score comfortably

Fought the bridle in the early stages - sat behind the front group - asked for effort 2f out moving over to the left - hit the front approaching the final furlong and stayed on well but unable to overhaul the winner
Settled in the pack - driven with two furlongs left and kept responding - moved up into third late but not troubling the front two
Settled around midfield - asked for effort with 2f left - kept responding late but couldn't reach the front-runners
Tracked front pack from wide position - urged forward with two furlongs left - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished fifth
Handy early - urged for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - well beaten in 6th
Settled in the pack early - roused with over 2f left - moved left approaching the furlong marker and stayed on to finish seventh
Sat behind the pace - asked for effort and moved left with 2f left - dropped away late to finish 8th beaten 9 lengths
Tardy start - dropped to the back and laboured 2f out while drifting left - always out of contention
Held up towards back - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to threaten - finished tenth
Moved across to the right early - settled towards the back - couldn't get involved - well held in 11th
Made the running early - under pressure with over 2f left - quickly overtaken and dropped away - finished well held in 12th
Held up in the pack - checked severely over 1f out when going nowhere - unable to get back into it and finished well beaten in 13th
Settled towards the back - went wide rounding the turn two out - driven into contention approaching the final furlong and drifted right - got there in the closing strides
Settled with the front group early - drifted off a true line under pressure to hit the front inside the final furlong - couldn't find more when overtaken close home - beaten a nose into second
Handy early - closed strongly to loom up passing the furlong marker - outpaced by the front two close home to finish third
Held up towards the back - pressed on and made progress inside the last furlong - couldn't get to the front three close home - finished 4th

Went straight to the front - pipped by a whisker before the 4f point - regained the advantage entering the last furlong - lost the initiative approaching the final 110yds and dropped away tamely to finish fifth
Handy early - hit front after a furlong before giving way over 1f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Asked for effort early to hit the front - clear and going smoothly two out - stretched clear inside the final furlong and a half - edged in slightly near the line to hold on for the win
Settled with pack early - third at halfway - driven for effort two out - moved into second inside final furlong - unable to trouble the winner - kept battling to the line but denied by half a length
Sat close up in second - pushed to keep pace two out and slipped back to third with a furlong left - stayed on late but never got competitive - finished third
Settled just off the pace early - back among the trailing group after 2½f - up to 4th by halfway - unable to threaten leaders and faded in the final furlong
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the field - still there after two and a half furlongs - 5th at halfway - unable to close entering the straight before fading a furlong out to finish 5th
Slow to begin - settled at the back - 6th at halfway - being ridden along with 2 1/2f left - dropped away 2f out and finished well held

Settled in the pack early - still close enough to the front group entering the last two furlongs - moved left and pushed along before surging clear inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win

Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - eased across to the left approaching 2f out - made up ground inside the final furlong - moved into second close home - unable to get on terms with the winner

Drifted left at the outset - hit the front early before conceding it and shadowing closely - regained command under pressure 2f out - overtaken entering the final furlong - unable to find more and slipped back approaching the last 110yds - held on for third

Bumped at the break - eager and pulling through early stages - handy with the front group - boxed in with two furlongs left - pushed along - blocked again inside the final furlong - eased right for room and stayed on late to finish fourth
Pulled hard early - sat close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - weakened inside the last to finish 5th
Pulled hard early - settled midpack - pressed for effort with 2f left - nudged closer inside final furlong to finish sixth
Close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and stayed on into the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish seventh
Close up early - hit front then challenged from a furlong in before being overtaken 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 8th
Settled off the leaders early - pushed along with three furlongs left - stayed on at one effort inside the final furlong - finished ninth beaten just over eight lengths
Slow to break - fought for control early settling mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground into the closing stages
Drifted off line at the off - lost touch early and never featured - well held throughout
Went straight to front - margin narrowed with 3f left - moved through smoothly and edged clear entering straight - kicked away 150 yards out - kept finding more to score
Held up at back - still 7th with three furlongs left - moved into third turning for home - unable to close on winner inside final furlong and held second to the line
Urged forward early to sit handy - moved into second spot approaching 3f out but couldn't threaten up front a furlong later - slipped back to third and edged home flat late for 3rd
Sat close to the pace early holding a fair grip - third with 3f remaining - slipped to fourth and pushed along turning for home - couldn't find more in the last furlong finishing fourth
Held up towards the back early - moved into 4th with 3f left - eased back to 6th turning into the straight - stayed on same pace in 5th at the finish
Settled in the pack early - slipped back to 5th with 3f left - asked for effort turning in but found nothing over a furlong out - lost more ground in the closing stages to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - still down the field 3f out - lost more ground inside the final 2f and asked for effort - faded in the closing stages to finish 7th
Settled behind the pace - moved into second with 2f remaining - pushed to the front inside the final furlong - stayed on to prevail by a whisker
Settled in the pack early - boxed in for room over 2f out - shifted left to find space - into third a furlong out - closed strongly to be denied by a whisker
Slow to stride - dropped to the back of the field - driven up 2f out - strong run 1f out - took third late on - closest to the front at the line
Sat close to the front pair early on rails - looked for room from over 2f out - moved left and asked for effort a furlong out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth beaten a length and a half
Went straight to the front - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken and urged out inside final furlong - dropped away quickly after finishing 5th
Held up towards the back - driven to close ground into contention over 2f out and briefly fought for fourth - then dropped away quickly to finish sixth
Handy early - urged forward with two furlongs left - soon lost ground meekly - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the off - urged forward with two furlongs left - responded and edged clear late - held on comfortably for the win
Tracked leaders in second - urged forward from 3f out and driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on without reeling in the winner beaten a half length
Held up early behind front group - urged forward 2f out and stayed on - lacked the speed to get closer
Held up towards the back - driven up to make ground approaching 2f out - under pressure and unable to quicken final furlong - finished fourth
Held up towards the back and pushed early - urged with 2f left - finished without threatening - beaten 3 lengths in 5th
Sat close to leading duo - pressed for effort and lost touch inside final 2f - well held at the finish
Led from the off - controlled tempo in front - roused with two furlongs left - driven out in the closing stages to hold on
Settled just behind pace early - improved to challenge 3f out - driven approaching final furlong and briefly slipped to third - rallied gamely to regain second on the line
Settled in third early - pressed the front pair over a furlong out - moved into second inside the final furlong - caught close home to finish third
Settled at the back early - lost touch from 3f out - responded and made late progress inside the final furlong - lacked the speed to get on terms at the line
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left then angled to the far rail and made ground approaching the final furlong - finished strongly to get up right on the line
Went straight to front - driven out with over a furlong left and drifted right under pressure - battled on gamely - caught in the final strides for second
Tracked front group early - shifted right and driven on 2f out - kept on late without threatening to land it
Held up at the back - progress inside final two furlongs then pushed along to fight for third with a furlong left - kept going at one speed to finish fourth
Handy early - urged into effort with 2f left - dropped away final furlong - finished 5th beaten 3½ lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - kept going without gaining much ground
Settled in a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish seventh
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with over two furlongs left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished eighth
Held up at the back - urged into effort at halfway - failed to quicken - finished ninth
Sat close to the pace early - dropped away with 2f to run - beaten into 10th

Settled towards the back early - pushed along and made progress 2f out - closed on the front-runner approaching the final furlong - stayed on to hit the front inside the last 110yds - went clear for an easy win
Set the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and holding a length's advantage entering the last furlong - couldn't find more and gave way close to home to finish second
Settled close to the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - gave up second place into the final furlong - held on at an even effort to finish third
Settled around mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left and eased over to the right - nudged closer inside final 110yds to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away with a furlong to run - weakened close to home to finish fifth
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and stayed on at one effort late
Settled in the front rank early - pressed for effort and dropped back inside the final two furlongs - faded through the last furlong to finish well held
Held up towards the back - pushed into contention over 2f out to challenge up front - stayed on strongly to get up close home
Settled in midfield early - made progress from 3f out - hit the front 2f out under pressure - stayed on well inside final furlong - caught close home for second
Sat close to the front group early - driven and dropped away over 2f out - urged to respond - found renewed energy inside the final furlong to finish strongly - just failed to get up close home
Slow to break - held up towards the back - urged forward with three furlongs left - responded to move up into fourth close home but held for a share of the minor honours
Sent to the front early - driven to hold advantage before being overtaken 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished fifth beaten 4.5 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along before the final 2f - faded steadily to finish sixth
Handy early in the pack - drifted right and asked for effort a furlong out - driven inside the last - kept on strongly to score in the closing strides
Went straight to the front - fought for its head early - pushed out in the closing stages and caught right on the line
Settled in second early - pushed along inside final furlong holding a shot at victory - couldn't find more and slipped to third close home
Settled handy early on outer - pressed the pace wide from 2f out - drifted left approaching the furlong marker - driven inside final furlong but faded to finish fourth
Handy with the pace early - lost ground two out and squeezed for space a furlong later - dropped away close home to finish fifth
Held up at the back - unable to make headway from 2f out - finished 6th
Held up at the back from the off - lost touch with the pack late on - eventually beaten well as the line came
Set pace from the off - urged forward with 2f left - drifted left inside final furlong needing driving - responded to pressure inside 110yds and held on gamely

Sat behind front group early - urged forward approaching 2f out - moved into second with a furlong left - challenged the front-runner and looked a threat close home - drifted left inside the final 110 yards then edged out in the finish
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left and finished well from a furlong out - unable to reel in the leading pair inside the final 110yds
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away and finished without further impact - eventually 4th
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort with 2f remaining - lost ground nearing the final furlong - finished 5th
Held in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find extra - eventually held in 6th beaten just under six lengths
Slow to begin - settled at back of field - driven approaching 2f out - never a factor and finished 7th
Held up at the back - failed to make an impression - finished well beaten in 8th
Sluggish start - held towards back of pack - pressed for effort 2f out but found nothing
Settled in third early - driven up to challenge with a furlong left - powered clear late - hit the front inside the final 110 yards - won going away
Up with the pace from the off - moved to the front inside the final furlong before giving way 110yds out - stuck on for second
Went straight to front - challenged approaching final furlong then edged out - couldn't find more late and slipped to third close home
Held up early - unable to quicken 2f out - dropped away thereafter - finished fourth
Dwelt at the break - stayed at the back of the field throughout - finished fifth
Handy early - asked for effort 2f out - closed on front-runner inside final furlong - battled to the line and got there by a whisker
